처음에는 얼굴처럼 가운데를 기준으로 나누기 쉬운 대상을 추천해요. 익숙해: Start with something easy to split down the middle, like a face. Later, try a day-and-night landscape or a cake with two flavors. Agree on a subject without planning every detail, then enjoy the surprise.

그림 시작부터 친구 초대, 경계 힌트, 채우기와 실행취소, 완성 그림 저: The Half Drawing guide: start, invite a friend, use boundary clues and tools, then save your finished picture.
처음이어도, 반쪽이면 충분해요: Even for beginners, half is enough
반쪽그림은 두 사람이 같은 주제로 왼쪽과 오른쪽을 나누어 그리는 작은 그: Half Drawing is a drawing game for two people. Draw the left and right halves of a shared subject without seeing your friend's full picture, using only a small clue at the boundary.
1. 주제를 정하고 친구를 초대해요: 1. Choose a topic and invite a friend
홈에서 ‘그림 시작하기’를 누르면 왼쪽 그림판이 열려요. 처음에는 ‘화난: Choose Start drawing on the home page to draw the left half. Try a simple subject with one fun detail: an angry strawberry, a crying onion or a sleepy cat. A face with different eyes and a mouth is enough; backgrounds and bodies are optional. Pick and edit an idea from Topic ideas, or try Today's silly topic on the home page. It changes at midnight in Korea. Each day's draft is separate from your regular drawing draft.
그림을 그린 뒤 아래의 주제와 그림을 확인하고 ‘반쪽 그림 등록’을 눌러: Check your topic and picture, then choose Submit my half. In the larger drawing view, choose Done drawing to return to the submission area. Submitting creates an invitation link and a code. Your friend can open the link or enter the code to draw the right half. Invite them within 7 days, before the code expires.
처음에는 고양이 얼굴, 로봇, 꽃처럼 가운데에서 연결하기 쉬운 주제로 시: Try a cat's face, a robot or a flower first. Their center lines are easier to connect than lettering or a complicated landscape.
2. 경계에 작은 단서를 남겨요: 2. Leave a small clue at the boundary
친구는 내가 그린 왼쪽 전체를 볼 수 없어요. 가운데 점선 바로 옆의 좁: Your friend cannot see your whole left half. They see only a narrow strip beside the dashed center line. Leave useful clues by drawing connecting lines all the way to the boundary: a forehead and chin, or the top and bottom of a robot's head.
아래 버튼으로 화면을 바꿔보세요. ‘친구의 화면’에서는 왼쪽 대부분이 가: Use the buttons below to switch views. Your friend's view hides most of the left half, leaving just the boundary clue and the empty right half. This helps you decide which clues to leave.
3. 도구는 필요한 만큼만 써요: 3. Use just the tools you need
Draw with the pen and correct with the eraser. Their sizes are remembered separately. Select a tool before opening its size settings. A wider eraser is useful for large areas.
색상 창의 기본 색을 누른 뒤 미리보기로 색을 확인하세요. 고른 뒤에도: Pick a palette color and check the preview. The panel stays open so you can compare colors. Use the drawing button or Close to return. Recent colors let you reuse colors you have drawn with.
물감통 모양의 채우기를 고르고 색을 정한 뒤, 선으로 둘러싸인 안쪽을 한: Choose the paint bucket and a color, then tap inside a closed outline. Gaps can let the color escape. Undo, close the gap with the pen and try again. Fill works only inside your half.
실수한 선이나 채우기는 실행취소로 되돌려요. 작은 화면에서 정교하게 그리: Undo removes a mistaken stroke or fill. Use Draw larger for finer work on a small screen. Close the larger view to return to the full picture.
친구가 오른쪽 그림을 제출하면 두 반쪽이 합쳐진 전체 그림을 볼 수 있어: When your friend submits the right half, both halves are revealed together. The person who started can reopen the drawing from My gallery. Different colors and mismatched shapes are part of the fun. Leave each other a note of up to 80 characters on the result screen. You can edit or delete your own note. Your friend's note updates while the page is open. Only the two participants can see the notes.
완성 화면에서는 그림 원본과 주제·반쪽그림 이름이 들어간 공유 카드 중에: Save or share the original drawing, or a card with the topic and Half Drawing branding. Check for personal information or anything your friend does not want shared. If image sharing is unavailable, save a PNG instead.
내 보관함은 현재 브라우저의 익명 이용 정보와 연결돼요. 시크릿 모드 종: Your gallery belongs to this browser's anonymous session. Closing an incognito window, deleting site data or using another browser may make your old gallery inaccessible. Save your favorite pictures to your device.
5. 역할을 바꾸고, 내 그림을 정리해요: 5. Swap roles and organize your gallery
완성 화면의 ‘역할 바꿔 한 판 더’로 같은 친구와 다음 그림을 시작할: Choose Swap roles, play again on a finished drawing. The previous starter can request another round, and the previous partner draws the left half this time. Once that half is submitted, the previous starter can choose Continue your friend's half on the old result screen. Join by pressing the button; there is no need to send a new code or join automatically.
두 사람 모두 이전 완성 그림을 열면 신청과 다음 그림의 준비 상태를 확: Both participants can reopen the previous result to check the request and next round. The topic starts with the same text but can be edited. The next round's draft is separate from regular drawings.
내 보관함에서 ‘친구의 새 한마디’가 보이면 해당 그림을 열고 친구 글을: A New note from your friend badge in your gallery means there is a note to read. It clears after the note is actually displayed. A new or edited note shows the badge again.
정리하고 싶은 그림은 ‘보관함에서 숨기기’로 내 목록에서 숨길 수 있어요: Use Hide from gallery to organize your list. Undo immediately, or restore it from Hidden drawings. Your friend's list and the original picture stay intact. Hidden drawings also have All, Started and Joined filters.

별도의 이메일·비밀번호 회원가입 없이 그림을 이용할 수 있어요. 그림을: You can draw without signing up with an email or password. Starting or joining a drawing creates an anonymous Supabase identity, used to check room participants and retrieve your gallery.
서버에는 방 식별자와 참여 코드, 그림 주제, 참여자 식별자, 방 상태와: The server stores room IDs and invitation codes, topics, participant IDs, room status and creation/expiry times, and submitted strokes, colors, widths and tools. 코를 가운데 경계에 붙이고 입선을 짧게 이어두세요. 친구에게는 왼쪽 그림: Place the nose at the boundary and add a short mouth line. Your friend sees only a narrow strip near the center. Nose height and the chin connection establish the size of the right half. Draw eyes and whiskers freely away from the boundary.
오른쪽은 표정부터 다르게 그려보기: Give the right half its own expression
참여하는 사람은 위아래 연결선의 높이를 먼저 살펴봐요. 턱과 이마를 이어: Check the heights of the upper and lower connecting lines. Join the chin and forehead, then add an eye and ear. Try another color or expression instead of guessing an exact match. The surprise grows with your different choices.
얼굴 크기가 달라졌다면 눈부터 옮기기보다 경계에 닿는 이마와 턱을 먼저: If the faces differ in size, adjust the forehead and chin connections first. Ears and cheeks can differ while still reading as one cat.
Before filling the face, check for gaps at the ears and chin. If color escapes, undo, close the gap with the pen and fill again.
네모난 머리와 몸통을 이어 그려요. 직선의 높이는 맞추고, 눈과 버튼의: Join a square head and body. Match the heights of straight lines and imagine your own eyes, buttons and functions.
머리와 몸통의 가로선: The horizontal head and body lines
한쪽은 청소 로봇, 다른 쪽은 간식을 만드는 로봇: One half cleans, the other makes snacks
머리와 몸통의 크기 정하기: Choose the head and body sizes
큰 네모를 머리로, 조금 작은 네모를 몸통으로 잡아요. 두 네모 모두 가: Use a large square head and a slightly smaller square body, both extending left from the center line. Leave room for a neck so the parts are easy to tell apart.
머리의 위아래와 몸통의 위아래 선이 가운데 경계에 닿도록 해요. 네 줄의: Bring the top and bottom lines of the head and body to the boundary. Those four heights show your friend the sizes and positions. Put arms on the outside and legs below, keeping the boundary clues simple.
버튼과 도구에 다른 역할 담기: Give buttons and tools different jobs
오른쪽을 그릴 때는 보이는 선 끝에서 수평으로 이어 머리와 몸통을 먼저: Continue horizontally from the visible endpoints to finish the head and body, then add eyes, an antenna and buttons. Discover the left half's functions after the reveal and give your combined robot a name.
경계에서 네모의 높이가 어긋났다면 큰 네모를 통째로 지우기보다 어긋난 끝: If square edges do not meet, erase and reconnect only the mismatched ends. Rounded corners can soften a small difference in height.
머리와 몸통을 각각 닫힌 선으로 그리면 채우기로 부위마다 다른 색을 넣기: Close the head and body outlines so they can be filled separately. Pen and eraser sizes are adjusted separately after selecting each tool.
꽃의 가운데와 줄기를 기준으로 꽃잎을 더해요. 모양을 똑같이 맞추지 않아: Add petals around the center and stem. Different colors can form one flower even when the shapes don't match.
처음 보는 색의 꽃: A flower in an unexpected color
한쪽은 봄의 꽃, 다른 쪽은 밤에 피는 꽃: One half blooms in spring, the other at night
가운데 점선을 중심으로 동그라미의 왼쪽 반원을 그려요. 꽃잎부터 시작하면: Draw the left semicircle against the center line. Starting with petals can make the center hard to find. Let both ends touch the boundary so your friend can judge the right half's size.
꽃잎 크기를 섞고 줄기는 단순하게: Mix petal sizes, keep the stem simple
반원 바깥에 큰 꽃잎 두세 장을 더하세요. 줄기는 가운데 근처에서 아래로: Add two or three large petals around the semicircle. Extend the stem downward near the center and add a leaf on the left. Leave space between clues so the center and stem remain distinct.
Use the visible center's height to complete the right semicircle. Petal counts and shapes can differ. Try pointed petals beside round ones, or dark colors beside bright ones. Name your flower after the colors that meet.
꽃잎 안을 채웠는데 이웃 꽃잎까지 같이 칠해졌다면 둘 사이가 연결되어 있: If filling one petal colors its neighbor, their outlines may be connected. Undo and close the gap, or keep them as one patch of color on purpose.
작은 꽃잎에는 가는 펜을, 넓은 꽃잎에는 채우기를 써보세요. 색상 창에서: Use a fine pen for small petals and Fill for broad areas. Check a palette color in the preview before closing the panel. Colors you draw with appear in Recent colors.
